scope: Benchmark current 2024 CUMCM Problem B model and algorithms against official showcase papers and one open-source full solution.

q1.reason: p1 and Nmax are business inputs not fixed by the prompt.

q2.reason: Exact absorbing Markov evaluation is strong, but the forced-inspection recovery interpretation is not yet implemented as a named challenger.

q3.reason: Exact enumeration of 65536 fixed policies is preferable to metaheuristics and has an external structural match in B196.

q4.reason: Raw sample counts are absent and rigorous interval branch-and-bound is not implemented.

required_actions: Govern p1 and Nmax as explicit Q1 inputs and report scenarios.
Implement forced_inspection_on_recovery as a Q2 challenger and validate it against an analytic oracle.
Separate fixed-policy enumeration from state-adaptive MDP claims in Q3.
Require raw N,K and implement an auditable simultaneous-confidence scenario audit before claiming Q4 robustness.

previous_test_evidence.command: python -m unittest q1.test_q1 q2.test_q2 q3.test_q3 q4.test_q4 -v
previous_test_evidence.note: This review did not change solver code; the test result is inherited from the immediately preceding implementation run.
